Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The error occurred because the WebSurfer agent failed to successfully retrieve or extract the specific CFM values from the initial web search results. Instead of identifying that the specific data was missing and immediately pivoting to a more targeted strategy or acknowledging the data gap, it proceeded to click on a YouTube link (Step 2) which only provided a visual description of the page and no numerical data. This led to a prolonged cycle of ineffective actions (repeated searches, clicking links, scrolling) without ever successfully locating the required numbers, indicating a failure in the initial information retrieval and verification process.
